title: Alchemy Horizons: Baldur's Gate: card flavor text

entities.name: Coast Way
entities.description: A road rumored to have bandits along it.

entities.name: Lady Bormul
entities.description: A landowner who claims an owlbear has been trampling her fields.

entities.name: Baldur's Gate
entities.description: A city whose rumor mill centers on a bakery.

entities.name: Seatower of Balduran
entities.description: An imposing seatower used as a prison.

entities.name: Wyrm's Crossing
entities.description: A bridge where traffic has halted amid cries of alarm.

entities.name: Lizard Marsh
entities.description: A marsh, presumably home to lizards.

entities.name: Dusthawk Hill
entities.description: A hill with caves below rumored to house a den of werewolves.

entities.name: Lord Jannath
entities.description: A lord who sent the reader to secure a mine from gnoll raiders.

entities.name: Ramazith's Tower
entities.description: A tower rumored to hide powerful artifacts and untold wealth.

entities.name: Rilsa Rael
entities.description: A figure who seems to need a large amount of hiexel bark.

events.summary: The reader arrives at Baldur's Gate with instructions to go to the bakery, the heart of the rumor mill.
events.quote: You arrive at Baldur's Gate with instructions to head straight to the heart of the rumor mill: the bakery.

events.summary: Traffic on Wyrm's Crossing halts amid distant cries of alarm.
events.quote: you hear distant cries of alarm, and you notice that all traffic on the bridge has come to a halt.

events.summary: Lord Jannath sends the reader to secure a mine from gnoll raiders, but neither gnolls nor miners are found.
events.quote: Lord Jannath sent you to secure the mine from gnoll raiders, but so far you haven't seen any gnolls . . . or, for that matter, any miners.

relations.note: Rumors of the werewolf den are heard in the Outer City slums.
relations.quote: As you explore the slums of the Outer City, you keep hearing rumors of a den of werewolves in the caves below Dusthawk Hill.
